title: Title: Predicting Estimated Times of Restoration for Electrical Outages Using Longitudinal Tabular Transformers
comments: Substantially revised and expanded version. The experimental design and cohort construction were reworked, and all results were recomputed. An earlier version was presented at the non-archival AI4UP Workshop at AAAI 2025
